result.summary: 本文介绍了 DeepSeek-V3，一个总参数 671B、每 token 激活 37B 的 MoE 语言模型，采用 MLA 和 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [abstract][S1.p2]。模型在 14.8T token 上预训练，并经过 SFT 和 RL 后训练，完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时 [abstract][S1.p6]。综合评估显示，DeepSeek-V3 超越其他开源模型，性能与领先闭源模型相当 [abstract][S1.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。同时，研究追求强模型性能与经济成本的平衡，并探索无辅助损失负载均衡和多 token 预测等策略以增强模型能力 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: To further push the boundaries of open-source model capabilities, we scale up our models and introduce DeepSeek-V3, a large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 671B parameters, of which 37B are activated for each token.
With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.

Firstly, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing, with the aim of minimizing the adverse impact on model performance that arises from the effort to encourage load balancing.
Secondly, DeepSeek-V3 employs a multi-token prediction training objective, which we have observed to enhance the overall performance on evaluation benchmarks.

method.text: DeepSeek-V3 采用 MLA 和 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [S1.p2][S2.p1]。训练支持 FP8 混合精度，并设计了 DualPipe 算法以实现高效的流水线并行和计算-通信重叠 [S1.p3]。后训练阶段通过从 DeepSeek-R1 系列模型蒸馏推理能力，并进行 SFT 和 RL [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.

Firstly, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing, with the aim of minimizing the adverse impact on model performance that arises from the effort to encourage load balancing.
Secondly, DeepSeek-V3 employs a multi-token prediction training objective, which we have observed to enhance the overall performance on evaluation benchmarks.
In this work, we introduce an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate its effectiveness on an extremely large-scale model.

As for the training framework, we design the DualPipe algorithm for efficient pipeline parallelism, which has fewer pipeline bubbles and hides most of the communication during training through computation-communication overlap.
During the post-training stage, we distill the reasoning capability from the DeepSeek-R1 series of models, and meanwhile carefully maintain the balance between model accuracy and generation length.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多语言 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段扩展至 32K 和 128K [S1.p4][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，主要使用英文和中文，以及多语言基准 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p1]。后训练评估包括 IFEval、FRAMES、LongBench v2、GPQA、SimpleQA 等，并与多个基线模型比较 [S5.SS3.SSS1.Px1.p1][S5.SS3.SSS1.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: During pre-training, we train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T high-quality and diverse tokens.
We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens.
In the first stage, the maximum context length is extended to 32K, and in the second stage, it is further extended to 128K.

The base model of DeepSeek-V3 is pretrained on a multilingual corpus with English and Chinese constituting the majority, so we evaluate its performance on a series of benchmarks primarily in English and Chinese, as well as on a multilingual benchmark.

Apart from the benchmark we used for base model testing, we further evaluate instructed models on IFEval, FRAMES, LongBench v2, GPQA, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider 1 1 1 https://aider.chat, LiveCodeBench (questions from August 2024 to November 2024), Codeforces 2 2 2 https://codeforces.com, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024) 3 3 3 https://www.cms.org.cn/Home/comp/comp/cid/12.html, and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).

We conduct comprehensive evaluations of our chat model against several strong baselines, including DeepSeek-V2-0506, DeepSeek-V2.5-0905, Qwen2.5 72B Instruct, LLaMA-3.1 405B Instruct, Claude-Sonnet-3.5-1022, and GPT-4o-0513.

findings.text: DeepSeek-V3-Base 在大多数基准上取得最佳性能，尤其在数学和代码任务上，成为最强的开源基础模型 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1][S4.T3]。聊天版本在标准基准和开放式评估中超越其他开源模型，性能与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等领先闭源模型相当 [S1.p5][S5.SS3.SSS2.p1]。训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的损失尖峰或回滚 [abstract][S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Overall, DeepSeek-V3-Base comprehensively outperforms DeepSeek-V2-Base and Qwen2.5 72B Base, and surpasses LLaMA-3.1 405B Base in the majority of benchmarks, essentially becoming the strongest open-source model.
DeepSeek-V3-Base achieves the best performance on most benchmarks, especially on math and code tasks.

Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, on a series of standard and open-ended benchmarks.
Table 6 presents the evaluation results, showcasing that DeepSeek-V3 stands as the best-performing open-source model.
Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks.
The pre-training process is remarkably stable. Throughout the entire training process, we did not encounter any irrecoverable loss spikes or have to roll back.

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小型团队带来负担；尽管端到端生成速度已超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍，但仍有进一步提升的空间 [S6.p2]。这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然解决 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: Firstly, to ensure efficient inference, the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.

Secondly, although our deployment strategy for DeepSeek-V3 has achieved an end-to-end generation speed of more than two times that of DeepSeek-V2, there still remains potential for further enhancement.
Fortunately, these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware.
